# Exacli

> A CLI for the Exa AI API. Search the web, extract page contents, get cited answers, run Exa Agent research jobs, schedule search monitors, submit request batches, and build Websets from your terminal.

## Overview

Exacli calls the Exa REST API directly (https://exa.ai/docs/exa-spec.yaml). It prints markdown by default and a `{"ok":true,"data":...}` JSON envelope with `--json`. Every command has `--help`.

## Installation

```bash
curl -L https://github.com/SoftwareStartups/exacli/releases/latest/download/exacli-darwin-arm64 -o exacli
chmod +x exacli
sudo mv exacli /usr/local/bin/
```

## Configuration

```bash
exacli login                         # store the key in the OS keychain
export EXA_API_KEY="your-api-key"    # or use the environment (takes precedence)
```

Get a key at https://dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys

## Commands

- `exacli search <query>`: web search. Types `auto`, `fast`, `instant`, `deep-lite`, `deep`, `deep-reasoning`. Filters `--category`, `--include-domains`, `--exclude-domains`, `--start-date`, `--end-date`. Synthesis via `--output-schema` (text or object, with grounding), `--objective`, `--system-prompt`, `--stream`.
- `exacli contents <url...>`: page contents. `--text`, `--highlights`, `--summary`, `--max-age-hours`, `--snapshot-as-of`, `--text-verbosity`, section filters, subpages, extras.
- `exacli answer <query>`: cited answer. `--model exa|exa-pro|exa-research|exa-fast`, `--output-schema`, `--stream`.
- `exacli similar <url>`: pages similar to a URL (deprecated by Exa).
- `exacli agent run|get|list|cancel|stop|delete|events`: Exa Agent runs with `--effort`, `--output-schema`, `--input`, `--data-sources`, `--max-cost`, `--max-duration`, `--wait`, `--stream`.
- `exacli monitor create|list|get|update|delete|trigger|runs|run|batch`: scheduled searches that post new results to a webhook.
- `exacli batch create|list|get|cancel|delete|results`: async batches of `/search` and `/agent/runs` requests (beta).
- `exacli webset create|list|get|update|delete|cancel|preview|items|item|item-delete`: Websets (verified entity lists). Related: `webset-search`, `webset-enrichment`, `webset-monitor`, `webset-import`, `webset-webhook`, `webset-event`, `team`. All accept `--body <json|@file>` for any spec field.
- `exacli login` / `exacli logout`: manage the stored API key.

## Examples

```bash
exacli search "hottest AI startups" --num-results 5 --highlights
exacli search "Who founded Exa?" --type deep --output-schema '{"type":"text"}'
exacli contents "https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.15004" --text --max-characters 5000
exacli answer "Explain recursion" --system-prompt "Explain like I'm 5"
exacli agent run "List 20 robotics startups in Europe" --effort medium
exacli agent get agent_run_123 --json | jq '.data.output'
exacli monitor create "AI chip funding" --period 1d --webhook-url https://hooks.example.com/exa
exacli webset create --query "Series A fintechs in Lisbon" --count 20 --entity company --enrichment "CEO name"
```
